LESSON: MY 1.0 CREATION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation a) recognize themselves as uniquely and display them 3. How important a
Topic 1.2: My 1.0 Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My 1.0 Creation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. pray with their family members to promote unity
2. desire to participate in family prayers in order to grow in faith
3. identify items they share at home to enhance togetherness e) appreciate the importance of sharing at home for family unity every day……..’ Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration as they share meals, learning to learn as they read and recite the Bible

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. pray with their family members to promote unity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to pray with their family members to promote unity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. desire to participate in family prayers in order to grow in faith
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to participate in family prayers in order to grow in faith. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. identify items they share at home to enhance togetherness e) appreciate the importance of sharing at home for family unity every day……..’ Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration as they share meals, learning to learn as they read and recite the Bible
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify items they share at home to enhance togetherness e) appreciate the importance of sharing at home for family unity every day……..’ Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration as they share meals, learning to learn as they read and recite the Bible. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My 1.0 Creation.
2. Explain My 1.0 Creation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My 1.0 Creation.
4. Show that you can: pray with their family members to promote unity
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My 1.0 Creation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is My 1.0 Creation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. pray with their family members to promote unity
2. desire to participate in family prayers in order to grow in faith
3. identify items they share at home to enhance togetherness e) appreciate the importance of sharing at home for family unity every day……..’ Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration as they share meals, learning to learn as they read and recite the Bible

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
